_display_notes: 24h change is computed as (price − previous-session close) / previous-session close, anchored on Yahoo's daily candle series (second-to-last closed candle); Finnhub j.pc serves as the previous-session close when Yahoo is unavailable, and Yahoo's own regularMarketChangePercent when fewer than 2 closed candles exist. Probe-verified against Alpha Vantage prev-close basis (Oct 16/19, 2026): ORCL −4.6% here vs AV −4.64%, AAPL +0.4% vs AV +0.43%, ^TNX +2bp — the earlier meta.chartPreviousClose anchor (close before the 5d-window start; it printed weekly moves as daily changes, e.g. ORCL −9.3%) is no longer used. Prices themselves are untouched. Tolerances: 1-decimal rounding (≤0.1pp) and intraday-session timing gaps vs AV's last-queried session are expected.
CPI display is the FRED CPIAUCSL same-month YoY (Sep 2026 336.298 vs Sep 2025 324.245 = +3.72%), +0.8pp vs the prior 2.9% display anchor.
Fed funds display is FRED FEDFUNDS (Sep 2026 monthly obs = 3.75%) — 2026 cut cycle; the previous 4.75%/+25bp-hike literal was stale.
HY-OAS value is anchored at FRED BAMLH0A0HYM2 = 323bp (Oct 15, 2026); the on-screen day-change is a HYG-ETF inverse proxy (rounded ±15bp/%), not the ICE series itself.
Baa-SPREAD value 148bp = FRED BAA10YM (Sep 2026 obs); its +6bp change remained an unverified carryover.
